caption: The drawing features three spoons depicted in pencil, arranged vertically side by side within a centered square frame on a beige or light tan background. The first spoon on the left is shown from a top view, with an ornate handle that includes a detailed, intricate design. The middle spoon is drawn in profile, showing its side view and curvature, lacking surface detail but indicating the thickness and contour of the handle and bowl. The third spoon on the right is shown from a top view, similar to the first, but has a plain, undecorated handle with a wider and flat end. Below the square frame, there is a small rectangular diagram illustrating the outline and dimensions of a single spoon from a top view with marked measurements. The drawing uses only shades of gray and black, created by pencil lines and shading for form, shadow, and detail. The artist's signature "L. Meyers" appears at the bottom left of the square frame.
title: Small Pewter Spoon
